escalation_reason: Whether uv should change its release archive layout is a product and release-compatibility decision: the reporter acknowledges it would be a breaking change needing a major-version bump and setup-uv changes, and it is blocked on cargo-dist support.
rationale: The reporter asks uv to publish flat release archives (uv and uvx at the root) instead of nesting them under a target-named directory, to match the Windows zip layout and simplify streaming extraction. uv is working as designed; the request is for different behaviour, so enhancement, matching the reporter's label. Nothing reported is a defect in uv or another tool, so not external. A search_issues query on archive layout and top-level directory returned only the unrelated uv build backend issue (#3957), and a second query on cargo-dist archive layout returned no matches, so no duplicates were found. Escalated because the change is breaking and depends on a maintainer decision.
